name: PDFium
note: Compiled into the executable and unpacked to a temporary folder the first time a PDF preview is rendered. Source: https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries

name: FFmpeg
note: Runs as a separate subprocess, never linked into this executable. The installer ships ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe directly, together with its license text (ffmpeg-LICENSE); the portable build is not shipped with it and instead downloads it on first need, only with your explicit consent, from https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/9.1. Corresponding source for this build: that release page links it; the upstream tag is https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n9.1 and the source archive is https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.1.tar.xz

name: whisper.cpp
note: Compiled into the executable as the local speech recognition engine (CPU only, no network). Source: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp

name: Whisper speech models
version: ggml conversions of OpenAI Whisper (base, small, large-v3-turbo; 5-bit)
note: Not part of the installer: downloaded only with your explicit consent, from https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp, and checked against a pinned SHA-256 before use. Original models: https://github.com/openai/whisper

name: Silero VAD
note: Voice activity detection model used to cut silence before transcription. Downloaded only with your explicit consent, from https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/whisper-vad, and checked against a pinned SHA-256 before use. Original: https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad
